title: Command event
description: Published by a device on smart-gardening/{device_id}/events to report what happened to a command.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumped on any breaking change.

command_id.description: command_id of the command this event refers to.

duration_s.description: irrigation_started: planned duration. irrigation_finished: actual time the valve was open (can be shorter than planned).

reason.description: Why the command was rejected. Only in command_rejected.
